<div class="text-center">

# The Accessibility Gap
### Challenges in a Multi-Campus Structure

AYBU operates across four geographically distributed campuses (Esenboğa, Etlik, Bilkent, and Çubuk), while maintaining a single-point physical store.

<div class="text-left inline-block mt-4">

- **Unequal Access**: Students outside the main campus face significant travel and time costs.
- **Operational Inefficiency**: Manual, location-bound workflows limit service continuity.
- **Fragmented Service**: No centralized digital hub for department-specific materials.

</div>

**Mission:** Transform the physical service model into a **Hyper-Local Closed-Loop Digital Ecosystem** for equitable and continuous access.

</div>

---
layout: center
---

<div class="text-center">

# Literature Review and Research Gap
### Synthesizing Prior Work

A review of 12 peer-reviewed studies identified a critical gap:

<div class="text-left inline-block mt-4">

- Prior work treats **Service Quality**, **Hyperlocal Logistics**, **Web Performance**, and **Chatbot Support** as separate, isolated tracks.
- Existing platforms (Shopify, Amazon) are too generic for university-specific organizational structures.
- Local campus solutions are often legacy systems lacking mobile responsiveness and secure modern authentication.

</div>

**AYBUStore Contribution:** Integrating these tracks into a single, closed-loop intra-university model with measurable technical KPIs.

</div>

<div class="text-center">

# System Architecture
### Modular Feature-First Design

```mermaid {scale: 0.7}
graph TD
    Client[Responsive Web Client] --> Features[Feature-First Modules]
    Features --> Hooks[Custom React Hooks]
    Hooks --> Context[Context API State]
    Context --> Services[Firebase SDK]
    
    subgraph Backend
    Services --> Auth[Secure OTP Auth]
    Services --> DB[Firestore Schema]
    Services --> Logic[Cloud Functions]
    end
    
    Logic --> Routing[Campus Routing]
    Logic --> Support[AI Interaction Layer]
```

</div>

---
layout: center
---

<div class="text-center">

# Methodology and Development
### Agile / Scrum Execution

The project follows a 15-week timeline organized into **seven 2-week sprints**.

<div class="text-left inline-block mt-4">

- **Sprint 1-2:** Architecture setup and Authentication module.
- **Sprint 3-4:** Catalogue, Search, and Cart/Checkout logic.
- **Sprint 5-6:** Admin panel, Tracking, and AI Support integration.
- **Sprint 7:** Verification, Validation, and Closure.

</div>

</div>

layout: center

# Effort and Cost Estimation
### COCOMO Basic (Organic Mode)

| Metric | Calculation | Result |
|--------|-------------|--------|
| Estimated Size | Module Summation | 6.5 KLOC |
| Effort (Person-Months) | $E = 2.4 \times (6.5)^{1.05}$ | ~17.2 PM |
| Development Time | $T = 2.5 \times (17.2)^{0.38}$ | ~7.4 Months |
| Notional Cost | $17.2 PM \times \$1,500$ | ~$25,900 |

**Interpretation:** Pilot remains feasible with 5 developers over 3.5 months under strict scope control.

</div>
